data.opportunityTitle: Rural Business Development Grants & Technical Assistance

synopsis.responseDateDesc: Electronic applications due by 11:59 pm ET

applicantTypes.description: Nonprofits having a 501(c)(3) status with the IRS, other than institutions of higher education

synopsis.applicantEligibilityDesc: Eligible applicants must be located in a rural area of 50,000 people or fewer. For-profit businesses are not eligible.
synopsis.synopsisDesc: Grants support targeted technical assistance, training and other activities leading to the development or expansion of small and emerging private businesses in rural areas.
